title: Country Pop
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Messed up on the first take
Tripped up on the third
Mouth doing cartwheels
Around that cursed word
Mirror on the dresser
Phone on record
Cheeks getting warm
This is vocal war

[Pre-Chorus]
“Unique New York”
Yeah
It bites back (hey!)
Jaw doing laps
On a twisted track
But I breathe in slow
And I tap that beat
Turn a tongue-tied tumble
To a victory speech

[Chorus]
Unique New York
New York unique
Slow it down
Then increase speed
Break it in pieces
Build that streak
Unique New York
New York unique
From a tiny mumble to a clean technique
Unique New York
New York unique

[Verse 2]
Chalk on the sidewalk
Words in a row
Walk while I say them
Heel–toe–heel–toe
Laugh at the slip-ups
Highlight the wins
Each little stumble
Just training the grin

[Chorus]
Unique New York
New York unique
Slow it down
Then increase speed
Break it in pieces
Build that streak
Unique New York
New York unique
From a tiny mumble to a clean technique
Unique New York
New York unique
